projects.title: Agentic workflow orchestration and cross-facility integration
projects.local_translation: Model a bounded research workflow as stages, dependencies, approvals, retries, and evidence outputs. Do not represent the model as ORNL's internal implementation.

projects.title: Autonomous science and self-driving laboratories
projects.local_translation: Run a synthetic research loop with a human approval gate, deterministic verifier, provenance log, and explicit stop conditions.

projects.title: Codex for HPC kernel generation
projects.local_translation: Benchmark generated code against a small hand-written baseline with tests, timing, and failure notes.

projects.title: VENUS and AI-powered neutron imaging
projects.local_translation: Treat project artifacts as a synthetic instrument stream and test whether a detector can surface repeated failure patterns.

projects.title: Quantum communications for critical infrastructure
projects.local_translation: Simulate key rotation, link failure, observability, and recovery scoring on a synthetic critical-service network.

projects.title: Radioisotope nuclear batteries
projects.local_translation: Study durable state, low-resource operation, graceful degradation, and explicit recovery behavior in a software agent.

projects.title: AI and synthetic biology for polymer breakdown
projects.local_translation: Create a multi-agent evidence exchange where specialist agents must pass citations and uncertainty, not prose opinions.

projects.title: AWARE and early grid-wildfire detection
projects.local_translation: Build early-warning checks for project drift, repeated failures, dangerous assumptions, and resource exhaustion.

projects.title: AI security and cyber-resilience research
projects.local_translation: Test synthetic models against poisoning, drift, sensor failure, and misleading alerts while keeping all systems disconnected from real infrastructure.

projects.title: Autonomous chemistry lab
projects.local_translation: Use synthetic experiment records to study reproducibility, decision loops, and human review without running chemistry or robotics.

projects.title: ITAQPRO quantum edge node
projects.local_translation: Simulate a quantum-control workflow with synthetic measurements, drift, retries, and an approval gate.

projects.title: Automated microscopy and 4D STEM
projects.local_translation: Use public or synthetic image arrays to study reconstruction, data transfer, and model-assisted measurement selection.

projects.title: AGILE grid laboratory emulation
projects.local_translation: Build a disconnected synthetic grid emulator with digital-twin records, latency, failures, and human review.

projects.title: INTERSECT integration and virtual testbeds
projects.local_translation: Test workflow components against local software doubles instead of instruments, networks, or internal facility systems.

projects.title: INTERSECT software development environment
projects.local_translation: Study reusable service boundaries and documentation using small local components and synthetic data.

projects.title: SMART Plant field systems
projects.local_translation: Simulate field sensors, edge collection, sample queues, and model updates without deploying robots or collecting real field data.

projects.title: Software deployment at DOE facilities
projects.local_translation: Create a toy multi-platform build matrix with explicit dependencies, tests, and reproducible environment records.

projects.title: ORNL public software discovery surface
projects.local_translation: Use the catalog as a discovery index; verify each repository's own README, license, release identifier, citation data, and documentation before making project claims.

projects.title: Public workflow software contracts and local provenance reconstruction
projects.local_translation: Study synthetic measure/analyze/decide execution with evidence gates, bounded recovery and replayable provenance. Not a joint ORNL implementation.
